## Whats new

- **Sorting:** name A→Z / Z→A, expiry soonest / latest, quantity, calories, recently added
- **Grouped or flat view:** toggle category grouping; sort and view are remembered per browser
- **Search by name and date:** name, brand, barcode, category and expiry date (`2026-05`, `05.2026`, `15.05.2026`), multi-word
- **Filters:** expiry status (expired / expiring soon / valid / no date / quantity 0) and expiry date range
- **Expiry warnings:** highlighted rows, "in X days" / "X days ago" hints, category warning dots, clickable counters
- **Supply estimate:** days the stock lasts for N people (expired items excluded)
- **Full editing:** all fields in one add/edit form, quantity on add, barcode stored with the item
- **New batch & merge:** 📋 copies an item for another expiry date; same barcode + expiry increases quantity
- **CSV export** of the visible list
- **Polish & English card UI** (follows Home Assistant language)
- **New sensors:** calories, expired, expiring soon, supply days (recalculated at midnight) — ready for automations
- **Integration options:** warning days, number of people, daily calories
- **Requirement:** Home Assistant 2024.11.0 or newer
